# AUB HANDOFF Analysis

## Status Assessment
| Metric | Value | Status |
|--------|-------|--------|
| OOS Mean | 1.88 | ✅ Good |
| OOS Min | 0.43 | ⚠️ Weak fold |
| Exposure | 0.47–0.84 | ✅ Acceptable |
| Degenerate Folds | 0 | ✅ Clean |
| Champion File | (empty) | ⚠️ Missing |

## Concerns
- **Empty champion file** suggests initialization state or pipeline gap
- **OOS min < 1.0** indicates at least one fold underperforming

## Next Commands (3 lines)

```
aub status --lane 21b5700bf9943671
aub search --continue --target-oos-min 0.8 --max-iters 50
aub export --if-improved --notify
```
